prepare.description: Statements run once per library version before measuring, with `S` in scope; their bindings are in scope for `run`. Build the schema and the input here — only `run` is timed.

run.description: The expression to measure, evaluated in `prepare`'s scope. Must not throw: timing a throw measures error construction.

description: Consumer-level performance scenarios, keyed by id, measured by `spec check --perf` alongside the specs.
